askEmpty: Searches and reads your notes, and answers with links to the notes it used. It does not look at private notebooks or the trash.
askHint: Each question is answered on its own (earlier questions are not remembered)
askPlaceholder: A question about your notes (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
resizeColumn: Drag to resize the column; double-click to reset
bannerChanged: This note was changed elsewhere. When you save, you can choose which to keep.
bannerDeleted: This note was deleted or moved elsewhere.
changedReloaded: This note was changed elsewhere. It has been reloaded; check it and try again.
confirmDelete: Delete "{title}" permanently? This cannot be undone.
confirmDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
conflictMessage: This note was changed elsewhere after you opened it.
conflictReload: Reload the other changes (discard my edits)
deletedWhileEditing: This note was deleted elsewhere. To keep its content, copy the body and create a new note with it.
dragToReorder: Drag to reorder, or onto the trash
idInvalid: An ID can only use lowercase letters, digits, - and _
idTaken: A note with that ID already exists (including the trash). Use another ID, or leave it empty.
idTitle: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 64 characters). Empty for an automatic one
noteGone: This note no longer exists (deleted or moved)
notebookOrderNotSaved: Could not save the order of the notebooks: {error}
previewTitle: Switch to the preview of the body
fileSaveFirst: Save the note once before adding files
filesCheckTitle: Find unused files and broken references
filesInHistory: An earlier version of a note refers to it (putting that version back needs it)
filesRecent: Added within the last hour (may belong to a note being edited)
serverStatsTitle: Memory of the server and state of the search index
mcpTitle: Show the commands that register ebira as an MCP server with an AI client
mcpText: ebira is an MCP server. Register this URL with an AI client, and the AI can search and read your notes, and write in collab notebooks. Private notebooks are hidden from AI.
mcpClaudeCodeCommand: Run this command in a terminal. With --scope user, every project can use it.
mcpClaudeConfirm:
Register ebira with Claude Code, for every project:

{command}
mcpClaudeAdded: Registered with Claude Code. Its next session can use it.
mcpClaudeReplaced: Registered again, in place of {url}. The next session of Claude Code can use it.
mcpClaudeOther: Claude Code has ebira at another address: {url}.
mcpClaudeNotFound: Claude Code (claude) is not found on the machine of the server. Install it and open this again to register it with the button.
mcpClaudeRemote: The button works only in a browser on the machine of the server, as it registers ebira with the Claude Code there.
statsFailed: Could not read the server status: {error}
statsSys: Memory from the OS for Go
statsMemoryNote: SQLite's own memory is outside the Go heap and shows only in the peak memory.
statsUpdated: Updated at {time}; read again every {n} seconds
statsRestartTitle: Start the server again, with the same flags and environment (it reads the settings file again)
statsRestartConfirm: Restart the server? No client can use it for the few seconds until it is up again. The page reloads once it is.
importMarkdownTitle: Import Markdown files as notes (you can select the image files they refer to as well). You can also drop files on the page or on a notebook
importSummary: Imported {created} into {notebook}. Skipped as already imported: {skipped}, failed: {failed}
previewStyleTitle: Choose the look of the preview; it is written to preview.css, which you may change
previewStyleTry: Choose one to try it on the note open.
previewStyleFile: Use writes it to {path}, which you may change.
previewStyleConfirm: {path} is changed from the built-in style or is your own CSS. It is copied to {backup} before it is replaced. Go on?
previewStyleFailed: Could not change the preview style: {error}
styleDefaultDesc: The preview as the web UI draws it
styleBandDesc: Headings with rules and a band; bold in a warm color
styleDocumentDesc: A serif face, lines of a readable length, airy lines
styleLinedDesc: Lines under headings; crisp tables and code
searchHelpKeys: Press / to go to the search box, and Esc to clear the search.
searchHelpWords: Notes with all the words, anywhere
searchHelpPhrase: A phrase: the words in that order
searchHelpTag: Notes with the tag; tag:"two words" for a tag with spaces
searchHelpTagOnly: Tags alone: the notes with all of them, last updated first
searchHelpNote: They combine with AND, such as tag:todo "new york". Case, but for OR, and full-width or half-width forms do not matter.
settingsOpenTitle: Change the language, the theme, the text size, the style of the preview and the settings of the server
settingsBrowserHint: Kept in this browser, and applied at once. The language and the theme take precedence over those of the server below.
settingsAppHint: The notes folder and the address of the server that this app connects to. The settings window of the app changes them.
settingsPreviewStyleHint: Written to preview.css, next to the settings file.
sortNotSaved: Could not save the sort order: {error}
sortTitleReorder: Sort (s to switch; J / K or drag to move)
title: Title
gitSyncTitle: Commit the changes of the notes, merge those of the upstream branch and push
gitNoUpstream: The branch has no upstream branch, so the changes were only committed. Set one with git push -u in the repository.
gitConflictCopy: Kept this version. The other version:
gitConflictKept: Kept this version, or the changed one; the other is in the merge commit
gitUnreadable: Notes that could not be read: {n}
kindInPrivate: {name} is private, so AI clients cannot see this one either
archivedWithParentNote: In the archive with “{name}”; take {name} out to take it out
notebookRenameHint: Enter saves, Esc cancels. The folder keeps its name ({id}).
notebookFailed: The notebook could not be changed: {error}
confirmUnprivate: AI clients will be able to read "{name}". Continue?
confirmTrashNotebook: Move notebook "{name}" and its {n} notes to the trash?
confirmEmptyTrash: Delete everything in the trash permanently: {n} notes and {m} notebooks? This cannot be undone.
confirmPurgeNotebook: Delete notebook "{name}" and its {n} notes permanently? This cannot be undone.
kindDrop: AI only adds notes, and cannot read them
moveWhileEditing: Save or cancel the edit of the note before moving it.
moveToNotebookFailed: The note could not be moved: {error}
historyTitle: Earlier versions of this note, kept on this device
historyEmpty: No earlier versions yet. One is kept on this device each time the note is saved or changed.
historyNote: Kept on this device, not synced: up to 50 versions per note, and those older than 30 days are dropped except the 5 newest.
historyDiffLegend: Changes to the body if this version is put back: - is removed, + is added.
historySame: The same as the note now.
historyRestoreConfirm: Put back the version replaced at {time}? The note as it is now is kept in the history.
privateLost: No longer private, as its files changed outside (such as by a sync), so AI can see it: {names}. Undo makes it private again.
copyTitle: Copy as Markdown, with the title, to the clipboard (y)
guideAddTitle: Add the guide of ebira, notes that tell how to use it, as a new notebook
issueOpenTitle: Open the page to post a request or a bug of ebira on GitHub
versionCopyTitle: Copy the version, to tell in a report
markNamesHint: Say what each mark means, such as important for red. The names are kept with the notes, and mark:name finds the notes with one.
settingsApply: The server reads the settings when it starts. To apply your changes, choose Save and restart.
settingsNotesHint: Saved in the notes directory, and shared with your other machines.
settingsAuthNoPasskey: To use a passkey, register one first with ebira auth passkey in a terminal.
settingsWatchLabel: Watch the files of the notes for changes, and update the index
settingsMachineHint: A setting left at its first choice, or empty, follows the defaults shared with the notes (the Synced with notes tab); one set here wins on this machine.
settingsDefaultsHint: The defaults of the settings of every machine that syncs these notes. A machine's own settings (the This machine tab) win over them. How to sign in (auth), the notes directory and the address are each machine's own.
settingsProviderAuto: The one with an API key (default)
settingsTUIPreviewHint: Applies the next time the TUI opens.
settingsKept: Does not change on a restart. To change it, stop the server, then start it again, such as with ebira web.
settingsSearchHint: A change makes the index again the next time the server starts, also on your other machines.
settingsOverridden: The server was started with a flag for this, so a change here does not apply.
settingsChanged: Could not save: the settings were changed elsewhere after you opened them. Close this and open it again.
settingsDiscard: Discard the changes to the settings?
settingsSaved: Saved the settings. Restart the server to apply them.
settingsNoRestart: This server cannot be restarted from here. Run ebira server restart in a terminal.
settingsExecutableGone: This server cannot be restarted from here, as its executable is gone, such as when it was started by go run. Run ebira server restart in a terminal.
settingsRestartFailed: Saved, but the server could not restart: {error}
serverRestartTimeout: the server does not answer; check it with ebira server status
searchHelpMark: Notes with the mark, by its color or symbol (red, star…) or its name
searchHelpNot: A minus leaves out the notes with it: a word, a "phrase", a tag or a mark. Alone, the notes without it, last updated first
searchHelpOr: Either: OR in capitals joins two words, phrases, tags or marks, closer than AND
copyLinkTitle: Copy a link to the note (Y)
selectionHint: Cmd/Ctrl-click to add or remove a note, Shift-click for a range, Cmd/Ctrl+A for all; drag them onto a notebook to move them.
confirmMovePrivateMany: Some of the notes are in a private notebook; in {notebook}, AI clients will be able to read them. Continue?
toastNotebookTrashed: Moved the notebook {name} to the trash.
moveToTitle: Take the note out of the trash into a notebook
confirmMovePrivate: "{title}" was in a private notebook. Moved to {notebook}, AI clients will be able to read it. Move it?
authSignInText: This server requires a passkey. Sign in to see and change all the notes.
authExpired: The session is invalid or has expired. Sign in again.
authNoPasskey: This server requires a passkey, but none is registered. Run this command in the terminal to register one:
authRegisterText: Create a passkey for the web UI of this ebira server. Your browser or password manager keeps it, and asks for your fingerprint, face or PIN when you sign in.
authRegistered: The passkey is registered. Sign in with it next.
authRegisteredNone: The passkey is registered. The server does not require passkeys yet: set auth: passkey in the settings file and run ebira server restart.
authTokenInvalid: This registration link is used or has expired. Run ebira auth passkey again.
authUnsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys here.
authCanceled: Canceled, or the passkey was not available.
authWaiting: This dialog moves on to the sign-in by itself once the passkey is registered.
deviceText: A program without a browser, such as the ebira TUI, asks to sign in with this code. Approve it only if the TUI in your terminal shows the same code; otherwise, cancel.
deviceApproved: Approved. The TUI signs in by itself in a few seconds.
deviceNotFound: This code is unknown or has expired. Open the URL the TUI shows now.
verifyText: This is an important operation, such as making a private notebook visible to AI, reading the history of a note or emptying the trash. Sign in with your passkey again to go on.
passkeyLast: The only passkey cannot be deleted. To remove every passkey, run ebira auth reset in the terminal.
confirmDeletePasskey: Delete passkey {n}? It can no longer sign in. Delete it also from your browser or password manager.
confirmRevokeAfterDelete: The passkey is deleted. Browsers and the TUI it signed in stay signed in until their sessions expire. If it was lost, or someone else may have used it, sign out every other browser and the TUI now?
revokeSessionsText: Ending the sessions signs out the other browsers and the TUI; this page stays signed in.
confirmRevokeSessions: Sign out every other browser and the TUI?
passkeyAlreadyHere: This browser or password manager already has a passkey of this server. Add the new one on another device or password manager.
reorderNotebook: Notes are reordered in a notebook.
reorderTrash: Notes in the trash are not reordered.
reorderChosen: Chosen notes are not reordered; drag them to a notebook to move them.
showArchivedTitle: The notes in the archive are hidden. Click to show them in the lists and searches too
hideArchivedTitle: The notes in the archive are shown too, marked with a box. Click to hide them
archivedFilterIdle: Not used in the lists of the archive and the trash
filterModeOff: Search: notes found come by relevance. Click to filter the list instead, kept in its order
filterModeOn: Filter: the list keeps its order, sub notebooks and separators, and shows only the notes matching. Click to search instead
notesUnarchived: Took {n} note(s) out of the archive
toArchiveTitle: Put in the archive: kept, but left out of lists and searches
archivedWithNotebook: In the archive with its notebook
archiveCandidatesTitle: Notes not updated for a while, to put in the archive
archiveCandidatesHint: {n} note(s) not updated since then, oldest first. Notes in the archive are kept, but left out of lists and searches.
archiveMore: {n} more; put these in the archive to see them.
